newsitem.title: CHINA: HSBC Asset Mgmt names new directors.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Asset Mgmt names new directors.

text.p: HSBC Asset Management Hong Kong Ltd, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, said on Friday it appointed Anson Wang as managing director, institutional, and King Au as director, head of global research group, Asia Pacific.
The company said in a statement that Wang would be responsible for business and product development across the institutional business in Hong Kong, China, Taiwan and Korea.
Au would assume full responsibility for overseeing and managing the research group based in Hong Kong, it said.
The statement did not give details when their appointment would take effect.
